# BLE SPP Client Example

ACL configuration parameters used BLE ACL example demo, Server for any ACL role can be used.

SPP Client default Configuration.

Sevice UUID: 00010203-0405-0607-0809-0a0b0c0d1910

Server to Client UUID: 00010203-0405-0607-0809-0a0b0c0d2b10

Client to Server UUID: 00010203-0405-0607-0809-0a0b0c0d2b11

## Function

When the ACL connected, the SPP client will discover the SPP server and read characteristic value of the SPP server.

Press Key 3 to write data to the SPP server using write without response. 

Press Key 4 to write data to the SPP server using write with response.
